title: Path drift on our own pack: does the from-empty vs top-up top difference change with age?

data.never_used: Challenge 2 proxy labels P_k and any error against them

events.cv_end: package rule in _step_depths: last sample of each run with pack >= 13.95 V and 0 < I < 6 A
events.anchor: package _first_full_charge of the segment (from-empty CCCV); must be the first CV end of its segment; anchors k = 0..7 in time order (k = 0: segment 1, 45 C)
events.T1_T2: the next one / two CV ends in the same segment
events.indexing: row index within the segment (timestamps are not unique)

ah_chain.code: src/ahchain.py (own implementation of the round 12 rule)
ah_chain.N: integral of current_A over (t_i, t_j] between two CV ends of the same segment, package convention _integrated_ah (dt > 600 s or dt <= 0 get zero weight)
ah_chain.thr: discharged Ah over (t_i, t_j]: integral of max(-current_A, 0), same weights
ah_chain.pairs: AT1 = anchor -> T1, AT2 = anchor -> T2, TT = consecutive top-ups; same segment only
ah_chain.gap_rule: a pair with any dt > 60 s in (t_i, t_j] is excluded (main estimates)
ah_chain.lambda_s: median of N/thr over the gap-free TT pairs of segment s; none -> pooled median of the segment's set point; that set point with < 2 gap-free TT pairs -> the other set point's pooled median (recorded as lambda_source)
ah_chain.sigma_TT: 1.4826 * MAD of r = N - lambda(-p) * thr over the gap-free TT pairs of a set point, lambda(-p) = the lambda rule for p's segment applied without p

sigma_TT_readings.reduced: the '< 2 TT pairs' test counts the pairs left after removing p (literal)
sigma_TT_readings.full: the test counts the full TT set; p is removed only from the median
sigma_TT_readings.gate_value: sigma_TT,25 for the noise gate = max(reduced, full), the conservative choice (both readings keep the rule; they differ at 25 C, which has only 2 TT pairs)

ah_chain.synthetic_test: src/test_synthetic.py; a planted A->T1 Ah offset must be recovered within 0.005 Ah

signals.P1: primary: Term3_k = N(A_k -> T1) - lambda_s * thr(A_k -> T1), k = 1..7 (25 C), gap-free AT1 pairs only
signals.P1b: robustness: Term3'_k = N(A_k -> T2) - lambda_s * thr(A_k -> T2), gap-free AT2 pairs only
signals.P1_45C_anchor0: Term3_0 with lambda of segment 1; reported separately, not in any trend
signals.S_gap: descriptive only, decides nothing: Term3_k for every AT1 pair including those with recording gaps, with the package integration (gap intervals > 600 s carry zero weight; the counters show no flow across the three gaps, WP0 F9). Same statistics as P1
signals.P2: consistency: dV_k = V30(T1) - V30(A_k) in mV, pack and per cell; P2_Ah = -dV / s_top (sign of Term3); s_top = OLS dV/dQ of the CK0 C/20 curve over discharged Ah in [0.5, 2.0] (pack: voltage_V; cell: that cell's curve). V30 = last rest sample at or before t_e + 1800 s, within 30 s of it, no gap. Statistics on pack P2_Ah; cells and cell mean reported
signals.P3: descriptive path memory, decides nothing: o_k = D1_k - D2_k with the package A3 robust step value and its dV/dQ variant (median over cells; 0.25 Ah grid); absolute shift o_k + Term3_k; anchor minus T1 CV Ah, CV duration and end current

statistics.d: Theil-Sen slope of the signal against fade_k over the available k in 1..7; at least 5 points, otherwise 'not estimable'. 'median E' = d * 8.2 Ah
statistics.loo: leave-one-anchor-out: the n Theil-Sen slopes on n - 1 points; LOO range = [min, max] of these slopes; E range = 8.2 * that
statistics.days: Theil-Sen slope against days since CK0 (anchor CV end - 2025-01-14), with its LOO range
statistics.bic: (a) constant, (b) linear in fade; OLS; BIC = n ln(RSS/n) + k ln(n), k = 2 for (a), 3 for (b); dBIC = BIC_a - BIC_b; 'BIC prefers (b) by >= 2' means dBIC >= 2
statistics.outliers: flag |r - median(r)| > 3 * MAD(r), raw MAD, r = Theil-Sen residuals (no flag if MAD = 0); flagged points stay in the main estimate; sensitivity without them
statistics.anchor_3: stays in the main estimate where its pair is usable; sensitivity without it. For P1 its A->T1 pair contains recording gaps (WP0), so the gap rule removes it from P1 and the sensitivity equals the main estimate; for P2 (voltages, no Ah chain) it is in

decision_rules_verbatim: Let E = d_path × 8.2 Ah, the effect at CK7.
Noise gate: σ_TT,25 ≤ 0.30 Ah. Otherwise the outcome is "not identifiable": report and exit after WP3's write-up.
Identifiability: the LOO range of E is ≤ 0.30 Ah wide. Otherwise the outcome is O3 "not identifiable".
O1 "path drift small": the LOO range of E lies within [−0.10, +0.10] Ah, and P1b's median E lies within ±0.15 Ah.
O2 "path drift material": the LOO range of E excludes 0, |median E| > 0.10 Ah, BIC prefers (b) by ≥ 2, and P1b has the same sign. Candidate "SUB + d_path" is leaderboard-only.

Combination with round 13 (only if R13_RESULT.json is available): d_top = d_tail + d_path, with medians added and ranges added endpoint-wise. Report it; it decides nothing in this round. It is passed to round 15.
No rule uses P_k or proxy errors.

decision_rules_operational.order: noise gate -> identifiability -> O1 -> O2 -> O3
decision_rules_operational.p1b_not_estimable: a condition that needs P1b (O1: |P1b median E| <= 0.15 Ah; O2: same sign) is not met
decision_rules_operational.loo_excludes_0: all LOO E strictly > 0 or all strictly < 0
decision_rules_operational.same_sign: sign(P1b median E) = sign(median E), median E != 0

known_from_wp0_structure.p1_set: gap-free AT1 pairs exist for anchors 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 (anchors 3, 7 have recording gaps between A and T1): exactly 5 points; each LOO fit has 4
known_from_wp0_structure.p1b_set: a second top-up in the same segment exists only for anchors 5 and 6: 2 points < 5, so P1b is not estimable and neither O1 nor O2 can be reached. Attainable outcomes: 'not identifiable', 'O3 not identifiable', 'O3 inconclusive'
known_from_wp0_structure.p1b_identity: segments 10 and 12 each have a single TT pair (T1 -> T2), so lambda_s * thr(T1 -> T2) = N(T1 -> T2) and Term3'_k = Term3_k exactly for k = 5, 6: P1b carries no independent information here
known_from_wp0_structure.tt_25C: 2 gap-free TT pairs at 25 C (segments 10, 12); anchor segments 2, 4, 6, 8, 14 use the pooled 25 C lambda

agreement_reported.P2_vs_P1: sign of the median E, overlap of the LOO E ranges, difference of the median E
agreement_reported.P1b_vs_P1: estimability; per-anchor Term3' - Term3 for anchors with T2

wp2_crosscheck_r12: if round 12 wp3/pairs.csv is on origin at WP2: shared pairs matched by segment and CV-end times; N must agree within 0.001 Ah; mismatches recorded, never resolved by editing either side
combination_r13: if R13_RESULT.json is on origin at WP3: read d_tail median and range; d_top = d_tail + d_path (medians added, ranges endpoint-wise; d_path range = its LOO range). Reported; decides nothing
soh_variants: wp3/SOH_variants.csv, leaderboard-only, never scored against proxies: SUB (wp0/SUB_SOH.csv) and SUB + d with d = d_path median, LOO low, LOO high (and d_top if available), built with the copied sources/r11/drift.py add_drift(soh, d): Q' = Q + d * max(0, 100.41 - Q). If d_path is not estimable the rows are not built and this is recorded
deviation_policy: WP2/WP3 driver scripts only call the registered functions and write files/figures. Any change to a registered file after this commit is a deviation, recorded in notes/DECISIONS.md with the reason and the diff, and reported in the WP report
